note: Inputs are the 30 isolated Orbit roots the orchestrator sessions filed into, the per-session label -> crew mapping, the blind reason sheet, and R015's and R016's committed artifacts/assignments.csv as the comparison. code/score.py collect writes artifacts/assignments.csv and artifacts/sessions.csv, which are committed. Session logs are under output/ (not tracked).

inputs.name: orbit-crew-pref-r017
inputs.source: $HOME/.orbit-crew-pref-r017/<session> on dk-server-1 (CREW_PREF_ORBIT_BASE), one root per session in code/sessions.tsv, workspace ws_crew-pref

inputs.name: mapping
inputs.source: data/mapping.tsv: the crew behind each label in each session

inputs.name: reasons-blind
inputs.source: data/reasons-blind.csv: crew reasons shuffled, without orchestrator or session, for blind coding
